Subject: Deal HW procurement handshake: order windows, cloud backfill, and OEM staging credits

Team, Oliver, Lisa — quick note to align on timing and the handshake we'll need between OEM orders and cloud reservations for Acme AI (DEAL-9832). Lisa has signaled a hard launch target in mid-July; per our sizing this will require ~120 dedicated A100-equivalent slots across two tranches. Key unknowns to close this week:

- OEM lead time commitment window (order cut / earliest ship / staging in OEM RMA pool)
- Cloud reserve carve-out (ability to hold burstable capacity in us-west for June–Aug)
- Any short-term staging credits or trial pods we can use as a bridge if OEM ETA slips

Attachments: AcmeAI_Demand_Schedule_Q2.xlsx (demand cadence + preferred tranche dates). Oliver, can you confirm whether the v3 quote timing in OEM_quote_v3.pdf supports a partial ship in June? Cloud Sales — please advise on reserve quota and minimum commit needed for a guaranteed backfill. Ben/Karthik/Maya: I'll consolidate answers and propose a mutual action plan for procurement cutoffs and fallback policy.

Thanks,
Jordan Blake

Subject: Re: Deal HW procurement handshake: order windows, cloud backfill, and OEM staging credits

Jordan — thanks for the summary and the spreadsheet. Short version from OEM side: lead times are currently 14–18 weeks for full production A100-class rack shipments once a PO is acknowledged. We can offer a staged fulfillment: 40% of units in the first production wave (14 weeks) and the remainder in a follow-on wave (~18 weeks).

Two potential bridge levers we can provide:
1) Staging pool allocation: we can hold ~10% of the order in our regional staging pool for 4 weeks post-shipment to buy time for on-prem install scheduling. This requires a written staging addendum.
2) Early ship trial units: we can divert 8 GPUs as a paid early trial shipment (partial configuration) to be delivered ~10 weeks from PO to help validate integration/perf.

I'll attach the updated quote (sent to Jordan offline) with wave dates and a draft staging addendum. We need a PO by 30 Apr to hit a first-wave ship in late June. If you need an earlier ship, we have premium expedite lanes but pricing delta will apply.

Oliver Park
Director, Strategic Accounts — OEMCo

Appreciate the clarity, Oliver. A few operational notes from procurement/ops:

- PO cutoff to meet Oliver's first-wave ship: 30 Apr (Jordan, please confirm approved PO owner and approver list from Acme).
- If OEM provides 10% staging pool, we should reserve that for the onboarding sprint (install + perf tuning). Plan to sign the staging addendum alongside the PO.
- Cloud backfill ask: Cloud Sales — can Stratum provide a guaranteed 30-day reservation for up to 40 instances in us-west with self-serve scale-down? We'll treat this as a paid short-term bridge; Acme prefers not to assume OS/hardening work on cloud instances, so we also need ephemeral images and network templates to speed cutover.
- Finance: we'll model the expedite lane cost into the deal scorecard only if Acme requests earlier ship.

Action items: Jordan to confirm PO owner by Mon 26 Mar; Oliver to send formal staging addendum draft; Cloud Sales to propose reserve SKU and commit terms. I'll stand up a procurement Milestone doc once we have the PO owner.

-Ben

Subject: Re: Deal HW procurement handshake: order windows, cloud backfill, and OEM staging credits

Ben/Jordan — Stratum can stand up a short-term reserved pool in us-west with these terms:

- Reserve window: 30 days minimum, extendable in 30-day increments.
- Capacity: up to 50 GPU-equivalent slots (can be smaller tranches: 20/30 split).
- Price: standard burst/spot-insured reserved SKU + 20% premium for guaranteed availability.
- Rapid image boot: we can pre-bake images and a network template; we will also provide a shared S3 bucket with init scripts for onboarding.

Request from our side: a written commitment that Redwood will accept a split billing model for the bridge capacity (we invoice Stratum usage during reserve window; Redwood will reconcile to Acme as part of monthly usage). Also need a signed MSA addendum for the reserved tenancy.

We can have a draft reserve order by Mon 26 Mar if Jordan confirms the tranche sizes.

— Sarah Chen
Account Lead, Stratum Cloud
cloudsales@stratumcloud.com

Thanks everyone — short confirmation and next steps from infra/ops:

1) PO by 30 Apr to OEM: we will accept the two-wave schedule (40% / 60%) and plan for on-prem staging for the first wave. Ben — please confirm the cadence for install crews and rack availability; we need a 2-week window post-ship for racking + power verification.

2) Cloud reserve bridge: agreeable to Stratum's terms. Jordan, confirm tranche split (I recommend 30/40/50-day alignment with Acme demand). We will pre-bake the onboarding image and a KV cache snapshot to speed cutover.

3) Contingency: if OEM slips beyond 6 weeks from their stated first-wave ship, we switch to an expanded cloud backfill (up to 80 instances) and trigger the expedite lane purchase (finance will approve if Acme sign-off exists).

4) Documentation: I'll create the procurement Milestone doc and include the staging addendum draft. Target to circulate the live plan Mon 27 Mar.

Karthik Iyer
Director, Infra Operations, Redwood Inference
